title: Study notes and flashcards
audience: For students who want an AI study partner that remembers what they keep getting wrong.
description: A flashcards app: study what's due a card at a time, in five boxes. Add and edit cards yourself, or paste your notes and your AI makes the cards.
tagline: Flashcards that come back when you need them.
seoTitle: Study notes and flashcards template for AI

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Study notes and flashcards". It is an app; its data is "Study/Study notes and flashcards.app/data.json". Read it with fetch before each change. When I paste lecture notes or a chapter, make five to ten flashcards with edit: add { id, q, a, topic, box: 1 } to values.cards. When I say "quiz me", ask me one card at a time, lowest box first, without showing the answer. After each answer, tell me if I was right and update the card: box up one (at most 5) when I get it right, back to 1 when I don't, and seen set to today. I can add, edit and delete cards in the app myself.

- Glucose is broken down to make ATP, the cell's energy.
- Three stages: glycolysis, the Krebs cycle, the electron transport chain.
- Most ATP comes from the electron transport chain, in the mitochondria.
